title: App
description: An App is the top-level product surface for a business function — the product face of a grouping anchor (a Domain or Group). It is the container above Module in the UI hierarchy and surfaces the business function it realizes.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the app.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what this app surfaces.

realizes.description: The business grouping anchor (Domain or Group) this app surfaces, by name.

modules.description: The Modules that make up this app. Each entry is the PascalCase name of a Module defined in this UI.

items.description: A reference to a Module by its PascalCase name.

examples.name: Lending
examples.description: The product surface for the Lending function.
